  code engine
  number_processors 1
  update_problem true
end service

  code analyze
  number_processors 1
end service

begin criterion 1
  type mechanical_compliance
  minimum_ersatz_material_value 1e-3
end criterion

begin criterion 2
  type volume
end criterion

  type mechanical
  service_id 2
  dimensions 3
  residual_ids 1

  type mechanical
  load_ids 1
  boundary_condition_ids 1 2
  material_interpolation_id 1

  minimum_value 1e-3

  scenario_ids 1
  weights 1
end objective

begin output 1
  service_id 2
  output_data true
  data dispx dispy dispz
end output

  type fixed_value
  location_type nodeset
  location_name ns_fix
  degree_of_freedom dispx dispy dispz
  value 0 0 0

  location_name ss_sym

  direction y
